From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Recap + proposed POC timeline (next steps)

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Call recap:
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency customer-facing recommendations (sub-200ms median for 512 tokens) and embedding accuracy for semantic search.
- Key success criteria (tentative):
  1) Latency: median p50 < 200ms, 99th < 500ms under test load of ~50 rps.
  2) Quality: top-5 retrieval MAP >= 0.72 on your eval set.
  3) Stability: no more than 1% error rate during simulated peak windows.
- Data / access: you’ll provide a 10k-record eval set + a sampled production request trace (anonymized).
- Roles: Alex (technical lead), Priya (procurement / legal), Neha (Redwood AE), Marissa (CS / onboarding).

Proposed POC timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (kickoff): Oct 12 — kickoff call, confirm access + success criteria, share SOW.
- Week 1: Test environment setup, dataset ingestion, baseline runs.
- Weeks 2–3: Iterative tuning (model variants, quantization), weekly check-ins.
- Week 4: Final readout + decision (roll/no-roll).

Action items for this week:
- Alex / Priya: confirm kickoff date (we penciled Oct 12) and provide data access scope and preferred contact for infra.
- Priya: procurement timeline / any required agreements (NDA/SOW).
- Neha / Marissa: prepare trial SOW and trial checklist (attach after confirmation).

I’ll draft a formal POC plan and SOW once we lock the kickoff date. If Oct 12 works for you I’ll send calendar invites and prep materials.

Thanks — Neha

--
